subject: noodles production-environment backup (operator machine, macOS/APFS home)

local.role: fast tier; only tier reading live sources

usb.role: replicates from completed local snapshot only (frozen source)
usb.history: single-slot rotation: no hardlinks, each snapshot ~4.6G full cost (2.9G APFS source)
usb.space_rule: min_free 4G, keep floor 1; threshold derived from measured snapshot cost vs 29G disk with ~19G foreign usage
usb.mount_guard: mount | grep ' on /Volumes/SANDISK ' before any write

gdrive.account_lock: path-embedded account (GoogleDrive-<account>@gmail.com); MCP folder owner asserted from metadata
gdrive.role: text-manifest lane only: Brewfile, versions, bootstrap, restore map

gnu-rsync.why: exit 24 (vanished sources) is warning-class; wrapper maps 24 to success explicitly

link-dest.why: hardlink dedup for unchanged files across daily snapshots on APFS

mcp-drive-text.why: create_file with textContent for manifests; owner field is the account assertion

openrsync.reason: macOS stock rsync fails the whole transfer on one vanished/changed file on hot sources; also no /./ relative anchor

apfs-localsnapshot-unattended.reason: tmutil localsnapshot works unprivileged but mount_apfs -s returns Operation not permitted without root; unusable for an unattended agent

cloudstorage-direct-write.reason: TCC denies terminal processes access to ~/Library/CloudStorage until the human grants Full Disk Access and restarts the app

binary-over-mcp.reason: MCP file content transits model context; a 5MB tar.gz is ~6.7M base64 chars, far beyond per-call limits

volatile_zones: noodles/.noodle (whole tree excluded from wide copy; durable subset via dedicated small rsync + 3 retries)
noodles/.worktrees (per-lane runtime worktrees with nested caches)
